verdict.rationale: Stripe documents registrable webhook endpoints and event destinations for asynchronous payment events. It also documents Smart Retries that automatically retry failed payments, plus recovery analytics on failure and recovery rates. Its hosted MCP server lets an agent read and write any Stripe API method, including invoices and subscriptions. Missing for 10: explicit failed-payment event types (e.g. invoice.payment_failed) in the evidence, documented dunning/customer outreach (failed-payment emails), an explicit agent-driven retry flow (Smart Retries is framed as no-code automation), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
